# Compose Specification schema

Unmodified upstream schema, bundled for offline validation.

- Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/compose-spec/compose-spec/914ec15d1fa498969c0df5c1d672306db3256089/schema/compose-spec.json
- Commit: `914ec15d1fa498969c0df5c1d672306db3256089`
- SHA-256: `d61cc3df8c6e6a727043e84f3405c69ffd63d341f629db8480f1d2ee5405b10c`
- License: Apache-2.0; see `SCHEMA-LICENSE`.

Frontend and backend validators use this same file. Schema updates require explicit dependency review and shared fixture verification.

The browser uses Ajv 2020 standalone output generated by
`frontend/scripts/generate-compose-validator.mjs`. This avoids runtime `eval`
under the existing CSP. `npm run ui:check` verifies that generated output matches
the pinned schema and Ajv version. Only this generated schema evaluator is outside
frontend coverage; NSC validation, semantic decisions, AST edits and sessions stay
in the measured source scope.
